method: All six full images directly inspected individually against saved generation briefs. Source SHA-256 recorded after inspection.
scope: Independent model review for finished gallery art, not human approval or gameplay/rig validation.

evidence: Separated two-hand grip, long straight blade and braced stance give a readable lateral guard.
Mature face, shaved hair, battered lamellar and frost-heavy cloak avoid glamour posing.
The thaw channel and challenger establish a defendable route in the glacial monastery.
nonblocking_limits: Hands are close together rather than widely separated; no visible grip failure.

evidence: Faceless hollow trunk and broad mineral leaves make the organism distinct from a humanoid tree guardian.
Lifting root, falling soil and opening sinkhole communicate environmental danger.
Botanical terraces and warm jade/amber atmosphere deliver mature luminous wonder.
nonblocking_limits: Branch roots and ground veins interweave; precise four-root topology cannot be completely verified in this perspective.

evidence: Repeated short legs and long segmented body read as functional parasite anatomy.
Head peeling from the exposed jade vein clearly connects ecology to action.
Gold behaves as worn shell colour, without decorative filigree.
nonblocking_limits: Body exits the upper frame; this is an expressive encounter view rather than a full body-length reference.

evidence: Single central prism and horizontal vanes establish an austere nonhumanoid optical sentinel.
Incoming light and two separated rainbow paths make the encounter function readable.
Court materials and mountain storm remain consistent with Avarra.
nonblocking_limits: Three legs are visible, with the fourth plausibly occluded. Exact count is not certified.
Spectral beams are unusually saturated relative to the restrained collection; cinematic optical shorthand, not physical optics verification.

evidence: Chain tension to the capstan, low hanging grapnel and wide planted stance communicate the naval control mechanic.
Adult face and practical soaked coat give strong human agency.
Suspended hull, crew and boarding parties distinguish the inhabited arsenal from an empty ruin.
nonblocking_limits: The taut end attachment wraps beyond the frame around the capstan; exact endpoint cannot be verified.

evidence: Unequal crushing claws perform two distinct actions: lifted hull and blocked escape ladder.
Ladder viewpoint creates immediate player-scale jeopardy.
Dark weathered shell, water weight and broken timber sustain adult creature realism.
nonblocking_limits: Water and shell occlude some rear walking legs; visible count does not constitute an anatomical turnaround.

conclusion: All six accepted. b18 is the narrowest pass because rainbow saturation is less restrained and anatomy is partially occluded, but no visible publication-blocking structural error was found.
